entities.summary: Caledonian Stadium, currently known commercially as the Sarens PSG Stadium, is a football ground in the Longman area of Inverness, Scotland, near the banks of the Moray Firth. It hosts home matches of Scottish League One club Inverness Caledonian Thistle.
